existing_socket_clock: socket_time_now selects emu.osd_ticks()/emu.osd_ticks_per_second() under validated host-wait path, retains legacy fallback otherwise
mechanism: With host socket waits, CPU time advances more slowly than wall time. The preview CPU-time interval therefore limits wall-frame delivery even when the browser requests frames promptly.

client_only_option.scope: Dashboard snapshot polling only; preview has an independent long-poll loop

proposal_scope: One preview-clock call uses the already selected socket clock. No timing change elsewhere, model/learner/replay algorithm change, or source edit performed.
possible_cost: More actual captures and browser-frame deliveries can add work and bandwidth for the selected actor; no free throughput gain claimed.
rollout_prerequisites: Actual original four-leg disposition and all owned closures complete; explicit quality source-freeze release
Fresh held-source/normal-mode identity validation and appropriate timing/capture checks
Evidence that added preview work has acceptable useful-throughput cost
Explicit new main/fleet provenance for any changed Lua; no live-source swap or actor restart during current comparison
